description: This file defines the LDAPTestConnectionAPI class, a REST API endpoint for testing LDAP connections within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It handles request validation, configuration of LDAP settings, and performs LDAP authentication and search tests, returning diagnostic information about LDAP connectivity and user lookup status.

classes.name: LDAPTestConnectionAPI
classes.description: Defines a REST API endpoint for testing LDAP connection configurations, performing authentication and search diagnostics, and returning diagnostic results including user count and status messages.

methods.description: Handles POST requests to test LDAP connection; validates input, sets LDAP configuration parameters, performs LDAP authentication and search tests, and returns diagnostic information.

methods.description: Performs LDAP authentication and entry collection fetches, then compiles and returns status messages including user counts and authentication status.

methods.description: Sets LDAP configuration attributes like bind DN and password based on request inputs, considering anonymous binding.

methods.description: Assigns data attribute mappings to LDAP configuration from request inputs.
